text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic young adult male character. Swept chestnut-brown waves, blue-gray eyes, clean-shaven angular jaw and straight brows; olive-brown vintage military-inspired tailored jacket, ivory shirt and dark tie, abstract geometric metal collar tabs. One centered chest-up studio ID portrait. Straight front view, eye-level camera, upright head, level shoulders, eyes looking directly at the camera, relaxed neutral closed-mouth expression. Consistent 3:4 portrait crop, full hair visible, pure white background, soft even studio lighting, realistic skin texture. Preserve a consistent individual face and hairstyle across all views. High-detail photographic skin, anatomically natural features, no watermarks, interfaces, logos or text.
original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Precisely correct the FIRST input portrait to match the SECOND input's framing and eye-level pose. The first image is the edit target and sole identity/clothing reference. The second is ONLY the composition template: DO NOT copy that man's facial features, hair, skin color or outfit. Preserve first man's facial identity, hair, eye color, skin tone, clothing and detail.
The first man's chin is tucked down and gaze looks up under brows. Raise chin to a true neutral eye-level passport pose, face plane vertical, camera at eye height, no tilt. Remove the golden side lighting; use even neutral studio lighting like the template. Reduce head occupancy by about 5%.
Output vertical 3:4 1086x1448, pure white background, centered nose x=50%, eyes level y=37%, bottom of chin y=63%, main hair top near y=6%. Keep both shoulders level, chest crop, relaxed closed mouth, no props, no text, one portrait.
